_note: AI director (ENG-08 stage 1) and navigation (stage 2). Units: seconds, counts, metres, degrees. Attack tokens: a Foamer may only attack while it holds a token of its attack kind, so only a few Foamers attack at once and arenas stay intense but fair (PLAN.md 4.3). Stage 3 adds the brain numbers here.

nav._note: Walkable grid baked from the physics world (ENG-08 stage 2), not a navmesh: carves and falling pieces change the level every few seconds, and a grid re-bakes a small rectangle in well under a millisecond. cellMetres: side of one cell. topMetres: the bake casts down from this height to find the ground. maxSlopeDeg: a cell whose ground normal is steeper than this is not walkable. agentRadiusMetres and agentHeightMetres: the shape cast standing on a cell; a cell that hits anything with that shape is not walkable. maxStepMetres: the tallest step an agent walks up between neighbours. rebakeMarginMetres: a rectangle re-bake also redoes the cells this far outside it (one agent radius, so a change next to a cell is seen from that cell's shape cast). stringPull: simplify a path to the fewest waypoints when a straight line between two of them clears every cell it crosses.

steer._note: Steering (ENG-08 stage 2), a pure function of position, path and neighbours. arriveRadiusMetres: inside this of the last waypoint the desired speed falls off to zero. separationMetres: two agents closer than this push apart. separationGain: the push speed per metre of overlap (1/s), so two agents touching at half the separation drift apart at about 0.7 m/s.

story._note: Story preset (D10). Fewest Foamers attacking at once.

fury._note: Foam Fury preset. Most Foamers attacking at once.
